status: prospective DEVELOPMENT pilot specification; no task assignments or model executions created by this file
target: Can the intended fixed coding backends produce eligible patches and verified resolutions under the common harness? This is a feasibility comparison, not routing superiority or confirmatory inference.

selection.frame: All tasks in the fixed 12-task qualification manifest whose ORIGINAL terminal qualification outcome has accepted controls, after the initial batch has terminal records; exclude pallets__flask-5014 already used for outcome-guided diagnosis. Preserve every original failure. Later alternate-image or repair diagnostic outcomes do not enter this pilot frame, even if completed before its freeze.
selection.actual_n: min(8, K) where K is size of the above qualified frame; record K and actual N before any new model outcome; no extra task substitution
selection.ordering: Sort by SHA256 of UTF-8 seed_label + newline + instance_id; break hash ties by instance_id; select first actual_n. Freeze exact IDs and source hashes before inference.
selection.inference_scope: Conditional descriptive development results on the selected tasks; no repository or benchmark population-rate claim.

models.quantization: Q4_K_M candidate; exact conversion/source and all served shard hashes must be recorded before episodes
Q4_K_M candidate; exact conversion/source and all served shard hashes must be recorded before episodes

episodes.submission: cp2/wc2 explicit Submitted capture only, repaired unique evaluator identity and no-clobber; no salvage
episodes.paired_backend_order: Task pairs sequential within an agreed host slot; first backend determined by low bit of SHA256(seed_label + newline + instance_id + newline + order). Record exact order before launch.
episodes.token_note: Nominal generated-token ceiling589824 for one physical attempt or1179648 for two; input tokens and evaluator/runtime overhead reported separately. No claim that this worst-case allowance is affordable.

launch_conditions: Current qualification records complete and exact pilot manifest frozen
grader identity/cache and resume fixes validated deterministically; archives immutable
pinned Coder pair assets and serving hashes/context confirmed; no silent substitution by the old3B/7B pool
measured resource/throughput preflight fits the common declared limits; fixed-backend pilot may load backends serially but cannot establish simultaneous routing feasibility
ICLR next-slot rights respected; explicit release acknowledgement and agreed DTR slot before new accelerator work

shared_host.rule: No accelerator work until handoff. Reach hard block cap by resource/time, not results; preserve incomplete IDs and resume the same frozen queue in a later agreed slot. Do not stop another project.

report: all selected task/backend outcomes and exact denominators
Submitted/nonempty patch rates and capture/format/context/budget/evaluator exits

logical calls, physical requests, input/output tokens, elapsed time, model pins

decision_rule: Complete the frozen bounded pilot without outcome-driven replacement or early success stopping. Zero verified successes or dominant format/context/infrastructure failures trigger further development diagnosis; do not launch learned routing or CONFIRM. Existing main protocol gates unchanged.
